title: Uptrend
description: From the 20,598 start, price dips to 20,529 (the first low), then makes highs of 21,394, 22,675 and 24,098. The last two are higher highs; the first has nothing to compare with. The straight run from 21,088 to 22,675 has no pivot inside it: a high only forms when price pulls back. The final close, 24,370, is the snippet high but its run has not ended.
